title: Task-weighted quality metrics and calibration pipelines for FP8/INT8 profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a task-weighted evaluation kit and calibration pipeline that verifies accuracy degradation bounds for FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles across representative workloads. Deliverables: (1) a reusable metrics library supporting perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy suites, BLEU/ROUGE/ROUGE-L, exact-match/F1 for QA, and task-specific scorers (summarization, translation, classification); (2) a calibration workflow that emits per-profile calibration artifacts (scale/zero points/FP8 exponents) and a standardized evaluation report; (3) CI gating and Console dashboard hooks that surface regression alerts when quantized model quality falls below thresholds. Scope: library and harness for offline eval + CI integration; does NOT include live runtime stack changes or autoscaling tuning. This ticket focuses on scoring, aggregation, and report surfaces for quantization validation.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics library provides stable APIs for: perplexity (cross-entropy), MMLU-style aggregated accuracy, BLEU (sacreBLEU compatible), ROUGE-1/ROUGE-2/ROUGE-L, QA EM and F1, and a plugin interface for task-specific scorers.
Calibration pipeline produces artifact bundle per profile (metadata, calibration stats, representative inputs) and stores them under s3://redwood-quant-calib/<model>/<profile>/<timestamp>/.

Automated eval run against canonical datasets: Wikitext-103 (perplexity), MMLU (multiple-choice accuracy), XSum/ CNN-DM (ROUGE), WMT subset (BLEU), SQuAD/TriviaQA (EM/F1). Results are persisted, and differences versus FP32 baseline computed with confidence intervals.
Regression thresholds plumbed into Console: team can set per-model, per-task SLOs and receive an alert if quantized profile drops below threshold by configured delta (absolute or relative).
Integration tests in CI that run the suite on a representative small model and fail if any critical metric declines beyond the threshold defined in the ticket.
Documentation: PRD-linked Confluence page describing scoring formulas, data splits, and how to add new task scorers.
implementation_plan: 1) Define canonical dataset list and shards for fast CI vs full offline evaluations.
2) Design metrics API (scorer interface, aggregation strategies, per-example traces) and implement core scorers (perplexity, MMLU aggregator, BLEU, ROUGE, EM/F1).

3) Build calibration workflow wrapper that: runs calibration collection, generates profile candidates (layer-wise/activation quant params), runs quantized inference harness, and emits evaluation artifacts.
4) Create result storage schema (flat JSON reports + CSV summary) and s3 layout for artifacts and baselines.
5) Add CI job using a small synthetic dataset and lightweight model to smoke-test scoring and gating.
6) Wire alerting hooks into Console via existing observability API and add dashboard tiles for quant-eval trends.
7) Write docs and a how-to for adding new task-specific scorers.
8) Run full offline validation for two models (one decoder-only, one encoder-decoder) and iterate on scorer edge-cases.
Estimated timeline: 6 sprints split across infra + metrics + docs; this ticket covers first 2 sprints (core metrics + pipeline prototype).
test_plan: Unit tests for scorer outputs with known inputs (BLEU/ROUGE golden vectors).
Repro tests: run full pipeline on FP32 baseline and confirm metrics match historical baseline within tolerance.
CI smoke: small-model run that verifies eval completes and returns expected keys in report JSON.
A/B validation: run FP32 vs INT8 vs FP8 and compute per-example deltas stored to allow manual inspection for high-variance samples.
Statistical reporting: include bootstrap confidence intervals for aggregate metrics and mark unstable tasks in the report.
End-to-end: onboarding doc checklist followed and a demo run presented to ML infra and product teams.
risks: Dataset licensing or PII issues when storing artifact traces — mitigation: scrub example inputs and store only hashed identifiers for sensitive workloads.
Metric mismatch across libraries (e.g., sacreBLEU vs custom BLEU) — mitigation: adopt and pin reference implementations and include versioning in reports.
High variance on small eval sets causing noisy alerts — mitigation: require minimum sample size and bootstrap CIs before triggering a regression alert.
Performance overhead for full offline runs — mitigation: default CI runs use reduced shards; full runs scheduled nightly or on-demand.
Edge-case scoring for generative outputs (multiple references, partial credit) — mitigation: provide plugin hooks for task-specific scorers and document expected behavior.
